Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 26  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer incorrectly concluded that "Human Nature" is the fifth single from Michael Jackson's *Thriller* album. The actual fifth single from *Thriller* is "P.Y.T. (Pretty Young Thing)." This mistake likely occurred due to misinterpretation or misreading of the information from the Wikipedia page, where all singles released from *Thriller* are listed in order. The agent may have either missed the sequence provided on the webpage or did not correctly interpret the order in which the singles were released. This led to subsequent errors in identifying the lyrics of the wrong song for determining the last word before the second chorus.
